en: A black‑and‑white panoramic winter view over a low‑rise town with snow on the roofs. Wooden and masonry buildings with metal roofs fill the scene, and in the distance a church with a tower or dome rises above the skyline. Leafless trees line the streets. On one prominent building in the middle‑right area there is large painted text, and in the foreground a small number "211" is printed in the lower left corner.
